entries.title: Cool Runnings

violence.summary: Sports peril includes pushcart and bobsled crashes, some newsreel crash footage, a brief comic bar fight with bottles broken, and passing references to being shot or killed in a crash.

language.summary: Infrequent language includes mild and moderate insults, religious exclamations, comic threats, an outdated ethnic term, body-size jokes, and baldness jokes.

romance.summary: Romance is limited to a lingering kissing-booth kiss played for comedy and a couple of mild innuendo lines.

drinking.summary: Adults drink beer in bar and beach scenes.

handoffNotes: CSM notes fictionalization of the true Olympic story outside the four content flags.

entries.title: The Three Musketeers

romance.summary: Frequent innuendo includes cleavage-heavy costumes, partial nudity from behind during a bath, kissing, wooing, seduction threats, and a groping attempt that is stopped with a knife threat.

handoffNotes: Suicide by jumping should be preserved in prose.
Romance/nudity content is stronger than most Disney-family entries in this batch.
